steps.clueRiddle:
Climb to the room where you dream at night.
Five secrets hide in plain sight — then make it shine!
steps.clueReveal: Race up to your own bedroom. First be a detective and find five things. Then clean the room until it passes hotel inspection!

challenges.title: Bedroom Detective
challenges.instructions: Your own room is the crime scene. Find each thing on the list. Tap to check it off.
checklist: The softest thing in the room
Something you have not played with in ages

challenges.title: Hotel Room Inspection
challenges.instructions: Clean your room until it looks like a hotel room. Beat ten minutes on the clock. Then a parent inspector does the white-glove check!
checklist: Clothes in the hamper or the drawers

steps.funFact: Detectives say the best hiding spot is the most boring one.

steps.clueRiddle:
Two paths split at the top of the stairs.
Builders go left, readers go right.
steps.clueReveal: This is a Detour: pick Build or Books. Build a rolling machine, or hunt six special books. Choose the one you will be best at!

a.label: Build
a.blurb: Ten minutes, one rolling machine. Builders, start your engines.

challenges.title: The Ten-Minute Machine
challenges.instructions: Build something with wheels that really rolls. Use Lego or any blocks you own. Ten minutes on the clock!
checklist: It rolls when you push it

b.label: Books
b.blurb: Six special books are hiding on your own shelf.

challenges.title: Home Book Hunt
challenges.instructions: Search every bookshelf in the house. Find each kind of book. Put every book back where it was.
checklist: A book with an animal on the cover
A book with a number in the title
A book with your first initial in the title
A book you have read more than once
The dustiest book you can find
A book taller than your hand

steps.funFact: On the real show, teams argue about detours. You get to just pick.

steps.clueRiddle:
Who is quiet, quick and sneaky of hand?
A mountain of socks needs a ninja's plan.
steps.clueReveal: Who's the Sock Ninja? A parent dumps out the sock pile. Match eight pairs before three minutes run out!

challenges.title: Sock Match Showdown
challenges.instructions: Start the stopwatch, then dig in. Match eight pairs and fold each pair together. Beat three minutes to earn your ninja belt!

steps.funFact: Somewhere in every house lives one sock with no partner. Spooky.

steps.clueRiddle:
Hotels on the trip made beds so neat.
Now show them YOUR five-star sheet!
steps.clueReveal: Quick bonus mission! Make your bed like a fancy hotel bed. Smooth blanket, straight pillows, no lumps.

challenges.title: Five-Star Bed
challenges.instructions: Pull the blanket smooth and flat. Line the pillows up straight. Add one stuffed animal as the fancy touch.

steps.funFact: Hotel workers can make a perfect bed in under two minutes.

steps.clueRiddle:
The mat waits where the stairs stop climbing.
Race there — this could be your night!
steps.clueReveal: The mat is at the top of the stairs. Run to it and jump on. Tonight's standings could be BIG.
steps.funFact: Halfway through the season is when champions make their move.
